title: Uncontrolled parameter creation is not permitted
test_intent: Determine whether parameters introduced into the governed scope are either approved governed parameters or explicitly identified permitted non-governed parameters, with no uncontrolled parameter creation treated as governed information.

applicability.applies_when: The tested model, template, family, or deliverable contains parameters that can affect governed BIM information.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested subject contains no parameters within the governed S8 scope.

required_evidence: complete observed parameter inventory for the tested scope
applicable governed parameter registry or approved parameter definitions
declared classification of non-governed or visitor parameters where such parameters are permitted
change or approval reference for newly governed parameters where applicable

result_logic.pass: Every parameter affecting governed information resolves to an applicable governed definition or is explicitly classified as permitted non-governed information and does not masquerade as governed semantic authority.
result_logic.fail: One or more parameters affecting governed information have no applicable governed definition, approved change reference, or explicit permitted non-governed classification.
result_logic.not_applicable: No parameters within governed S8 scope are present in the tested subject.
result_logic.indeterminate: The observed parameter inventory or applicable governance/registry context is incomplete, preventing a reliable controlled-versus-uncontrolled determination.

provenance.migration_note: First S8 conformance pilot ATS. The test distinguishes governed, permitted non-governed, and uncontrolled parameter creation without assuming a tool-specific implementation.
